description: `<#userReq>.data is given` / `.error is given` in an `if=` attribute: on a 2xx settle #who mounts and #err never enters the DOM.
rationale: §6.7.7 Properties: `<#id>.data` "Most recent successful fetch result, or `not` before first success"; `<#id>.error` "Error from most recent failed fetch, or `not`".
